Ivy Martinez: quick flag - new int8 canary showing duplicate email sends due to streaming suffix oddity.
Kenji Watanabe: sample?
Ivy Martinez: trace:
REQ id=mail-900 tool=send_email
STREAM A: {"action":"send","to":"x@y.com","subject":"Hi"}
<stream cut>
client retried -> STREAM B: {"action":"send","to":"x@y.com","subject":"Hi","msg_id":"m-1001"}
Lena Ortiz: first chunk was parseable but SDK still flagged it because no trailer checksum.
Kenji Watanabe: Impact is double sends for side-effecting tools. Baseline float much lower.
Ivy Martinez: Short-term fixes: runtime TTL dedupe keyed by idempotency_token; SDK soft-accept if accumulated buffer parses and contract keys present; add chaos eval that simulates stream drops.
Lena Ortiz: I'll PR the SDK opt-in heuristic today.
Kenji Watanabe: I'll prototype runtime LRU dedupe (TTL 5s) and measure mem. For enterprise, expose opt-in.
ci-bot: Canary paused: sparrow-mail-int8 at 4% due to duplicate_toolcall_rate > 0.5%. Dashboard: https://ci.redwood/canaries/5555
Ivy Martinez: Filing ticket and attaching traces. ops-bot, standby for rollback if needed.
ops-bot: Rollback plan available: /ops rollback sparrow-mail-int8. :ok_hand:
Kenji Watanabe: Meeting tomorrow to sync on PRs. End thread.
